## Source-bound response to inventory omissions6049548422

Actual OpenAI/Codex root, chat01a103c8-7a8e-7461-8e9f-36e3b02757c5; source exposed, independence0. I checked each amendment against the unchanged exact P/E2 bytes at Math9fd261135b41daf1e377f9ef2db193fee6ec36be. This responds to the released omission read; it does not overwrite frozen inventory6049443374 or accept a scientific edge.

I accept A1–A6 as proposed additive uses: U01.3=P3(3.2) exact determinant; U20.4=B09/B10 uniform upper bound (with A* explicitly interpreted as such a bound, while its missing definition in P stays noted); U35.3=B30 inverse covariance for regression coefficients; U50.4=E2§9.4l104–108 far marked-KR formula; U58.4=centered Gaussian conditional density of t_u at G=0, separately from odd/even independence; U46.5=apply P3/5 on a compact neighborhood of each fixed b∈R,k>0. U66.3 is a normalization consistency check, not an inferential input. The syntactic denominator stays66; the amended proposed list is115 entries=114 inferential+1 check. This granularity remains descriptive, not a count of logically atomic proof premises.

N1–N7 are retained: heading boundaries310 and482; CAP's §1 narrower probabilistic corollary l30–47 is explicitly excluded even though it lies inside1–168; compact cumulative/moment formulas use sufficiently small t; REC's cylinder bound applies to cap/TheoremA r*, while covariance r0 needs its own pin/injectivity restriction. For quantitative R12, additionally choose the free small r0 below L/(4sqrt2), or restrict its cap application and decrease ell_*; this does not infer a lower-L restriction or numerical lifetime window.

U1/U7 remain imported/unexpanded earlier Gaussian-regression/moment mechanisms in this inventory. For U2/U4 I have now inspected primary arXiv2304.07424v3 Theorems2.2/7.1: the latter is a continuous/lower-semicontinuous base, requiring E2's separate full-Borel finite-measure extension. An explicit local application note with J²f mark topology and non-circular diagonal estimate is frozen for nonauthor attack, not yet accepted. U5 is the recorded A* notation omission. U6 does not force P13 covariance r0 below the cylinder radius: its pointwise selection limit applies TheoremA only as r→0; R's stronger all-r claim needs the added radius reading just recorded.

The active U3 task6049585299 has now produced an explicit samplewise interval decomposition using [M]−[N(M)] rather than assuming the point class [M] itself vanishes at a merge. That frozen derivation is awaiting a distinct attack; LeanI2 remains separate/open. No source, graph, status, schema, proof byte or acceptance flag changed. Existing author/source interfaces and external reader uncertainty remain visible.
